name: Thalia Hawthorn
source: Thalia, who is almost fatally injured after touching a spinning wheel in the fairytale world, is extremely afraid of needles. With her supreme body and charming smile, Thalia is hoping to become the most popular showgirl. Her honest effort and likable attitude tend to steal the hearts of many people.
